title: Find Region Names and Coordinates for a Point on the Human Brain
text: coord_closest_vertex(): find closest vertex mesh MNI305 space (e.g., fsaverage, fsaverage6, etc). Note: actually works brain mesh coordinate surface space, including native space meshes surface (white, pial, …). coord_MNI305_info(): find MNI305 coordinate (trivial) FreeSurfer 4x4 matrix accurate regfusionr method Wu et al. (requires optional regfusionr package). coord_MNI305_info(): find approximate Talairach coordinates using Matthew Brett’s piecewise-linear transform MNI152. Note approximation Talairach space, original Talairach atlas space (defined single post-mortem brain). can also get Talairach Daemon label (Brodmann area, lobe, etc.) point, see get_talairach_label() . aware Talairach Daemon defined true Talairach space, coordinates approximate — practice Daemon’s coarse labels tolerate well. vertex_closest_regions(): find region vertex assigned brain atlas parcellation like Desikan atlas comes FreeSurfer (trivial) vertex_closest_regions(): find distances atlas regions, different distance methods (Euclidean, geodesic along mesh) different linkages (defining reference point measuring distance region, e.g., closest vertex region, center vertex) coord_closest_regions(): coordinate instead vertex index. Important: overlay statmap data must template space subject used (typically MNI305 / fsaverage space). Passing native-space data produce incorrect coordinates atlas assignments. can specify different template via template_subject parameter. clusterinfo(): read cluster information statistical map (e.g., t-value map mesh vertices) overlay map assigning cluster identifier vertex. clusterinfo_from_thresholded_overlay(): read cluster information thresholded statistical map, using BFS mesh identify clusters. cluster_location_details(): find extremum value, vertex, MNI152 coordinates, Talairach coordinates, Talairach Daemon labels (Brodmann area, lobe, etc.), atlas region name cluster. main function producing results table. cluster_peaks(): find peaks cluster cluster_region_overlap(): given additional brain parcellation, find regions cluster overlaps compute percentage overlap cluster regions. get_talairach_label(): retrieve Talairach volume label point (5 level hierarchy, e.g., ‘Right Cerebrum, Temporal Lobe, Sub-Gyral, Gray Matter, Brodmann area 20’).
